title: feat: add tgpt Pollinations harness
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `polli harness tgpt on|status|off`, using tgpt's existing authenticated Pollinations text provider.
- Clears a conflicting generic `AI_API_KEY` from tgpt's config so the dedicated provider-specific key takes effect; defaults to `openai/gpt-5.4-nano`.
- Restores the previous configuration on `off`, preserves a subsequently selected provider, and documents config overrides.
- Bumps Polli CLI to `0.1.17` so the integration can publish on merge.

Validation: 116 CLI tests, package build, Biome, and missing-install/option-parsing checks passed. The original implementation was tested through real `on → tgpt request → status → off`; the key-precedence follow-up is covered by the configuration regression test and upstream source inspection.

gist.headline: Polli meets tgpt
gist.blurb: The hive now knows its way around tgpt. One command wires up tgpt’s authenticated Pollinations provider, and another puts everything back exactly where it found it.
gist.summary: Polli CLI 0.1.17 adds `polli harness tgpt on|status|off`, configuring tgpt’s authenticated Pollinations text provider with `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` as the default while handling the conflicting generic `AI_API_KEY` and restoring prior settings on exit.
gist.impact: Developers can connect tgpt to Pollinations with a single harness command, inspect the setup, and turn it off later without overwriting a provider they selected afterward.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cozy command-line mechanic linking a retro tgpt terminal to a Pollinations code-flower through a neat provider-specific key cable. The CRT Monitor Robot can display `tgpt: ON` while Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, carefully stores an old configuration scroll in a garden toolbox; lime-green terminal glow and code-plants make the connection feel reversible and well-tended.
